description: Unit tests for the HttpServer class in the net:: namespace, including request handling, WebSocket interactions, and connection management.

classes.name: TestHttpClient
classes.description: A helper class to simulate an HTTP client for testing the server.

classes.name: HttpServerTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing HttpServer functionality, implementing the HttpServer::Delegate interface.

classes.name: WebSocketTest
classes.description: A subclass of HttpServerTest for testing WebSocket request handling.

classes.name: WebSocketAcceptingTest
classes.description: A subclass of WebSocketTest that accepts WebSocket upgrade requests and tests WebSocket message handling.

methods.name: ConnectAndWait
methods.description: Connects the TestHttpClient to the server and waits for the connection to establish.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the socket.

methods.name: ReadResponse
methods.description: Reads a full HTTP response from the socket.

methods.name: ExpectUsedThenDisconnectedWithNoData
methods.description: Verifies the socket was used and then disconnected with no data.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates a connection to the server and waits for it to be established.

methods.name: WaitForRequest
methods.description: Waits for an HTTP request to be received by the server.

methods.name: HasRequest
methods.description: Checks if there are any pending requests.

methods.name: RunUntilConnectionIdClosed
methods.description: Runs the event loop until the specified connection is closed.

methods.name: HandleAcceptResult
methods.description: Handles the result of an accept operation with a socket.

methods.name: GetMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message received via WebSocket.
